version_message:
--- 0.5.0 Large update, many features added, and some bugs fixed. ---

Added the ability to change the icon of servers/instances [in the right-click contextmenu]

Added the ability to expand the instances/servers list into an expanded grid view.

Added an 'Add Shortcut' button for instances/servers that overrides the default icon of the server/instance [in the right-click contextmenu]

Added a folders/sections system, so you can group instances/servers.

Merged the Create Server and Create Instance dialogs into one.

Fixed autofilling of mods in the Modpacks and Resource Packs tabs in the mod manager.

Made it so the console output can be collapsed/expanded with a button on the side of it that only appears when you hover your cursor over it.

Added a Shaders tab in the mod manager for easy shader installing.

Added the ability to make a new server/instance specifically with/for a modpack (it has you choose one using the mod manager.) (this is in the 2nd tab in the create server/instance dialog window.)

Added a third tab in the create server/instance dialog window for importing a server/instance from another location on your computer (whether from a .zip or folder).

Added a dropdown menu in the server/instance configuration panel to choose what JRE version it will use. It has 'Auto' selected by default.

Made it so if it cannot detect a server .jar, it asks you if you would like to install the server .jar.

Fixed the server/instance .jar detection, so that the 'Args' box is accurate to what .jar it is launching, and with accurate arguments.

If you experience any issues, please contact me and let me know. Please keep in mind that Altair is managed and developed by one person only (@kronos.solaris on Discord), so bugs are inevitable. If you use Altair as your main software for playing Minecraft, please consider regularly making backups of your worlds and servers. Although it is not likely, it is entirely possible that I miss something when testing Altair, that may: Not allow you to launch the game, not allow you to start servers, etc. SKlauncher is a great and stable backup Minecraft launcher (however it does not support hosting servers) [get it at https://skmedix.pl].
